description: Surgeons in a territory whose main device company for a family (the one most engaged with them for its products) changed between the last two Open Payments years: who, from whom, to whom, with their Medicare cases, plus new and ended ties. Needs the product and company coverage add-on.

cities.description: Cities within the state, to narrow it.

counties.description: 5-digit county FIPS codes forming a custom territory.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

metro.description: Metro area by name ("Charlotte") or 5-digit CBSA code (16740). Can cross state lines.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit when giving a metro or counties.

zips.description: 5-digit ZIP codes forming a custom territory (as my_territories returns them).

name: switching
title: Surgeons whose main company changed
